tutorial.html:
Guess Who? (Declarative)

Ask yes-or-no questions about the other player’s secret character, then guess their identity. A correct guess wins; an incorrect guess loses.

Choose a question or tap a character to make a guess. Your secret character and question history are shown only to you.
